title: Stable Recovery of Matrix Gauge Classes from Pointwise Invariants
summary: A parameterized matrix family $x\mapsto H(x)$ on a configuration domain is determined by its physical content only up to a constant orthogonal change of basis. This gauge ambiguity is intrinsic to data-driven Hamiltonian models, such as tight-binding parameterizations, reduced-order electronic structure methods, or excited-state models. It raises a basic inverse problem: what observations of $H(x)$ suffice to identify the family up to this gauge? The pointwise spectrum is incomplete already for linear families on $\mathbb{R}$.
